title: Auth UX - Visible Sign In Button and Flow
description: Users should be able to easily find the sign-in option. Add visible Sign In button to header/nav that's always accessible.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Header shows 'Sign In' button when user is NOT logged in
Sign In button navigates to /login page
Login page has clear, user-friendly design
After successful login, user is redirected to /dashboard
Header shows 'Dashboard' link when logged in
Header shows 'Sign Out' button when logged in
Mobile: Auth buttons are accessible and properly sized (44px+ touch targets)

implementationNotes: Already implemented in Header.tsx - shows Sign In when logged out, Dashboard + Sign Out when logged in. The session persistence fix (US-AUTH-PERSIST) was needed to make this work correctly.
